children: Trio Petroleum Corp. (TPET) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 21, 2026.
On September 21, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing the signing of the Agreement. A copy of such release is furnished hereto as Exhibit 99.1.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1898766/000149315226043485/form8-k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1898766/000149315226043485/0001493152-26-043485-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
